name: Lumora MCP
purpose: A human and machine-readable design toolkit for selecting web-ready 3D models, owned-original and officially linked web components, design-engineering experiments, curated R3F/WebGL patterns, multi-style image and UI assets, and externally hosted animated background references.

modelSchema.modelUrl: Relative local path or official remote glTF URL
modelSchema.publicModelUrl: Absolute model URL for Codex and external consumers
modelSchema.files: Optional exact dependency URL map used to resolve streamed Poly Haven glTF packages
modelSchema.agencyUse: Recommended website role for the selected object
modelSchema.brandMoods: Brand moods this object can support
modelSchema.websiteIndustries: Agency verticals where the object is especially useful
modelSchema.sectionFits: Page sections where the object can earn its rendering cost
modelSchema.visualFidelity: Advisory geometry band: very-low-poly, standard-low-poly, or detailed-low-poly
modelSchema.selectionPriority: Advisory shortlist priority; never a hard exclusion rule
modelSchema.selectionGuidance: Art-direction warning or positive guidance to read before selection
modelSchema.bestFor: Visual contexts that fit this asset's actual style
modelSchema.avoidWhen: Visual contexts where the asset is likely to weaken the result
modelSchema.fallbackPolicy: How the asset may still be used when no stronger catalog match exists

modelSelectionGuidance.selectionFreedom: UNRESTRICTED: Codex may use, combine, and repeat any number of models or scenes anywhere on the page. Lumora imposes no usage rules.
modelSelectionGuidance.primaryRule: Do not infer art-direction fit from an object's name or category alone.
modelSelectionGuidance.kenney: Read visualFidelity, selectionPriority, selectionGuidance, avoidWhen, and fallbackPolicy before selecting a Kenney model.
modelSelectionGuidance.fallback: A low-poly Kenney asset remains usable when no closer match exists, but should be adapted deliberately and usually kept secondary unless low-poly styling is intentional.
modelSelectionGuidance.detailedArchitecture: Detailed-low-poly architecture may be shortlisted earlier for stylized spatial work, while still being compared with higher-fidelity sources for realism or luxury.

imageAssetSchema.conceptId: Normalized subject for comparing the same concept across visual styles
imageAssetSchema.imageUrl: Local path or official linked preview URL
imageAssetSchema.publicImageUrl: Absolute default preview or asset URL
imageAssetSchema.downloadUrl: Production asset, source page, or local asset URL depending on usageMode
imageAssetSchema.usageMode: bundled, grouped variants, linked source, or attribution
imageAssetSchema.variants: Optional named style or weight URLs grouped under one concept
imageAssetSchema.bestFor: Contexts where the asset style is a strong fit
imageAssetSchema.avoidWhen: Contexts where another visual family should be preferred

animatedBackgroundSchema.previewUrl: Original externally hosted MP4 or HLS media URL
animatedBackgroundSchema.downloadUrl: Direct MP4 download or adaptive HLS manifest URL
animatedBackgroundSchema.thumbnailUrl: Local 640x360 WebP extracted from the opening frame
animatedBackgroundSchema.publicThumbnailUrl: Absolute opening-frame thumbnail URL for external consumers
animatedBackgroundSchema.licenceClass: commercial-use based on Lumora owner confirmation
animatedBackgroundSchema.selectionFreedom: Unrestricted authority for Codex to use, combine, layer, and repeat backgrounds in any quantity
animatedBackgroundSchema.performanceGuidance: Advisory simultaneous loading, playback, and fallback guidance

imageSelectionGuidance.primaryRule: Style metadata is descriptive only. Codex has unrestricted authority to choose, mix, layer, and repeat any assets.
imageSelectionGuidance.consistencyRule: UNRESTRICTED: Codex may mix any icon families, illustration systems, weights, and visual styles in any quantity.
imageSelectionGuidance.groupedVariants: Phosphor weights are grouped for convenient access; grouping does not impose consistency or usage rules.
imageSelectionGuidance.linkedAssets: ambientCG preview images are not production PBR maps; fetch production maps from the official material page.

componentSelectionGuidance.ownedOriginal: Lumora owned-original recipes are implementation briefs built from first principles.
componentSelectionGuidance.originKit: OriginKit records link to the official current implementation and remote selection previews; source code and media are not mirrored.
componentSelectionGuidance.selectionRule: All metadata is descriptive. Codex has unrestricted authority over every selection, count, combination, placement, source, and repetition.
componentSelectionGuidance.previewEngine: All 85 owned archetypes have representative SVG compositions. Linked cards load a paused official opening frame only near the viewport; only the selected inspector plays motion. Previews guide selection and are not production source or media.
componentSelectionGuidance.reactBits: React Bits records link to its public registry, official live demos, and remote selection previews. React Bits Pro is excluded.
componentSelectionGuidance.canvasUi: Canvas UI records link to official six-framework registry variants and remote selection previews. Preserve documented browser fallbacks.
componentSelectionGuidance.linkedSourceBoundary: React Bits and Canvas UI allow commercial end-project use under their recorded terms. pmndrs example code and Arlan's Vault implementations are MIT-marked; visible demo assets and credited brand references remain separate boundaries.
componentSelectionGuidance.selectionSequence: Structure and enhancement are search labels only; they impose no workflow or order.
componentSelectionGuidance.sectionCanvasRule: Background records marked section_canvas can define heroes or sections and may be used, combined, and repeated without catalog limits.
componentSelectionGuidance.pmndrs: pmndrs Examples records are curated React Three Fiber/WebGL patterns with official static thumbnails, live demos, and pinned source directories. Codex may use and combine any number of scenes; implementation metadata does not limit selection.
componentSelectionGuidance.arlanVault: Arlan's Vault records are compact MIT-marked design-engineering experiments. Review them for typography, material, button, reveal, canvas, and GPU treatments; copy only the selected implementation and replace credited brand/demo media.
componentSelectionGuidance.selectionFreedom: UNRESTRICTED: Codex alone decides all record counts, combinations, placement, repetition, sources, and selection order. Lumora imposes no usage rules.

componentSchema.officialSourceUrl: Official detail page for a linked component
componentSchema.registryUrl: Optional official shadcn-compatible registry payload for the selected component
componentSchema.officialVariants: Available language, styling, or framework variants
componentSchema.previewVideoUrl: Optional official remote selection preview; never production media
componentSchema.selectionPass: Search label only: structure or enhancement; never a workflow or usage rule
componentSchema.enhancementFamily: Functional effect family used for pairing and duplicate detection
componentSchema.canBeStructural: True when an enhancement may also replace a section or widget
componentSchema.sectionCanvas: True when the enhancement can provide the full visual canvas behind a hero or section
componentSchema.requiresStructuralPairing: True when the visual must be paired with a semantic content structure
componentSchema.textOverlayCapability: Whether foreground text is supported and what readability condition applies
componentSchema.foregroundContentGuidance: How to layer real heading, body, CTA, and navigation content over the visual
componentSchema.overlayReadabilityGuidance: Contrast, scrim, quiet-zone, and reduced-motion requirements for foreground content
componentSchema.pairingGuidance: How to combine the candidate with the selected base composition
componentSchema.selectionFreedom: Explicit unrestricted authority for Codex to use and combine records in any quantity
componentSchema.codeUrl: Optional pinned implementation directory for linked open-source examples
componentSchema.originalSourceUrl: Optional original sandbox or upstream reference recorded by the source catalog
componentSchema.exampleLibraries: Exact libraries declared by the linked example metadata
componentSchema.assetRightsBoundary: Separates reusable example code from demo models, textures, audio, fonts, logos, and imagery
componentSchema.publicPreviewPosterUrl: Absolute URL for a linked record's optimized local selection preview
componentSchema.previewCaptureSourceUrl: Official page from which a local selection preview was captured
